texts.preamble: Kaleesuwari Refinery Private Limited vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 20 January, 2024 Author: Jyoti Mulimani Bench: Jyoti Mulimani -1- Nc: 2024:Khc-K:802 Wp No. 201092 of 2018 In The High Court Of Karnataka Kalaburagi Bench Dated This The 20Th Day Of January, 2024 Before The Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Jyoti Mulimani Writ Petition No.201092 Of 2018 (Gm-Res) Between: Kaleesuwari Refinery Private Limited, 53, Rajasekaran Street, Mylapore, Chennai - 600 004. Tamil Nadu, Represented By Mr.Ramesha.B., Manager - Quality Assurance. ...Petitioner (Absent) And: 1. The State Of Karnataka Represented By Deputy Commissioner, Raichur District-585 401. 2. Designated Officer, Food Safety And Standards Department, Digitally signed by Raichur District-585 401. Thejaskumar N Location: High Court Of 3. Designated Officer (Central Licensing), Karnataka Fssai Regional Office (South), Chennai-600 003. ...Respondents (By Sri.Veeranagowda.M.Biradar., Aga For R1 And R2; Sri.Sudhirsingh.R.Vijapur., Dsgi For R3)
texts.facts: The petitioner has not made any efforts to engage other advocate or to appear before the Court.
texts.arguments: Counsel Sri.Ganesh S.Kalburgi., submits that Sri.Deshpande.G.V., learned counsel who was attached to the office of Senior Counsel Sri.Ameet Kumar Deshpande., has filed a memo on 02.08.2023 stating that they have intimated the petitioner that the Advocate on record Sri.Ameet Kumar Deshpande., has been designated as Senior Counsel and hence, appraised the petitioner to make arrangement for appearance in the case.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Counsel Sri.Ganesh S.Kalburgi., submits that Sri.Deshpande.G.V., learned counsel who was attached to the office of Senior Counsel Sri.Ameet Kumar Deshpande., has filed a memo on 02.08.2023 stating that they have intimated the petitioner that the Advocate on record Sri.Ameet Kumar Deshpande., has been designated as Senior Counsel and hence, appraised the petitioner to make arrangement for appearance in the case.
